meta.title: TokenBank Free Models
meta.description: Free models for DSH: register with TokenBank to get a free API key with a $3 credit (unlock $2 more with any recharge or key deposit); free GLM models go straight into your model list. Balance, key deposits (temporary quota to permanent balance), daily check-in and CNY recharge (Alipay) included — no self-hosted relay needed. Tribute to dsh-our-free-model. https://bank.skillpie.cn

depositManageTip: One-click deposit: host your API key credentials on TokenBank to convert temporary quota into permanent balance. Useful when: 1. The weekly reset is close and quota remains unused — sell it to the platform for permanent balance (like a bank deposit) 2. Cross-provider calls — convert to TokenBank balance and switch to the model providers TokenBank offers 3. Deposited API keys are called by the platform first, earning deposit interest into your balance (like a bank loan) 4. When your TokenBank balance runs short, your own API key is withdrawn and used directly 5. TokenBank routes automatically, so you no longer need to switch models frequently due to insufficient usage
